verdict.rationale: Exporting data and leaving is a fair question for a SaaS monitoring platform, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented capability for exporting all of a user's data in open formats. Community comments about self-hosting, source availability and the existence of a CLI are adjacent options, not a documented export feature, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
